text.tspan: Diarrheal disease cases vs. safely managed sanitation 2023
Diarrheal episodes per 100,000 people. Safely managed sanitation is defined as single-household improved
sanitation facilities where excreta are safely disposed in situ or transported and treated off-site.
Share of the population using safely managed sanitation
Rate of diarrheal disease (cases per 100,000 people; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025); WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene
